name: get_account_details
description: Retrieve account details only after verify_customer returns verified=true for this call.

account_id.description: Internal mock account identifier; never speak it before authentication.

name: verify_customer
description: Verify the caller before any debt disclosure. The tool is authoritative for authentication state.

verification_code.description: Last four PAN digits or year-of-birth value spoken by caller.

name: log_promise_to_pay
description: Record a verified customer's confirmed PTP amount and exact payment date.

name: send_payment_link
description: Queue a mock payment link for a verified customer after a request or PTP.

name: escalate_to_agent
description: Queue a dispute, hardship, complex case, or customer request for a human agent.

name: mark_disposition
description: Record the single final outcome and end the call. Use immediately for DO_NOT_CALL and WRONG_PERSON.

notes.description: Brief non-sensitive note; never include verification data.
